title: [GMCP 203.043.05] Interoperability and quality: Cross-platform packaging, service integration, and distribution
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-043-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Identical supported GMCP capability is packaged for Linux, macOS and Windows across x86_64 and arm64 with signed, reproducible artifacts, service-manager integration, upgrade/rollback, uninstall, path/permission handling and diagnostics. A declared parity matrix has automated clean-machine, non-admin, Unicode-path, sleep/resume and upgrade tests; unavoidable platform differences are explicit and policy-safe. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
